g.text: Finding A Fair Match, Under A Clock
A player's acceptable rating window widens the longer they wait -- until it reaches someone already waiting.
The matchmaker never scans every waiting player -- only the ones already inside the current window.
It widens the window on a timer, and stops the instant two players' windows overlap.
A narrow window is fairer; a wide window is faster -- widening on a clock gets both, in the right order.
